status: Implemented, native bundle synchronized, reviewed migration applied to the dedicated Nisfayn database, and fictional-data web preview deployed.
entry: Discovery opens first for eligible members and demo visitors. Curated introductions remain accessible in their tab.
privacy: New public text is optional and explicitly labeled visible. Changes require existing profile re-review. Older clients preserve new details and do not newly publish family involvement. Private assessment answers, contact information and private photo URLs are not published.

compatibility.meaning: Priority-weighted reciprocal preference alignment from both members' assessments.
compatibility.method: Existing transparent matching algorithm; no learned AI inference or generative relationship prediction is enabled.
compatibility.gate: Percentage is null unless both members have all 30 valid answers and current marriage-v1 assessments.
compatibility.explanation: Shared strengths, topics to discuss and assessment coverage remain visible.
compatibility.limits: The percentage is an alignment index, not a calibrated probability of marriage success. Weekly discovery and private-chat eligibility limits remain unchanged.

portraits.purpose: Fictional demo identities only; no real member profiles were seeded.
portraits.delivery: First visible portrait loads eagerly; later portraits load lazily with reserved layout space.

deployment.previewIsolation: Dedicated demo build; live cloud client disabled and Content-Security-Policy connect-src restricted to self. No production service credentials.
